target_customer: Spreadsheet users who want Excel-like speed in the browser
problem: Online spreadsheets of 2009 felt slow compared with desktop Excel.
business_model: Unknown, in stealth; likely web app subscription

competitors.name: Google Spreadsheets
competitors.traction_then: ranked first among online spreadsheets in a 2009 ranking

competitors.name: Zoho Sheet
competitors.what: Ajax spreadsheet in the Zoho suite

technical_complexity.rationale: TechCrunch said the product had the speed and feel of Excel in a browser, which is hard in 2009 JavaScript.

defensibility.rationale: Performance could be a moat only if sustained; Google and Zoho already shipped and could improve speed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google Docs remained dominant; EditGrid shut down in May 2014. Skysheet's outcome is not documented.

market_need_then: Online spreadsheet use was growing with Google Docs and Zoho, and reviewers in 2009 compared them with Excel; Skysheet targeted Excel-like speed. Competitor sources are dated August 2009, about five months after the batch start.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches for name origin, logo, mascot, rebrands and press about the brand returned nothing about this company, so the brand is rated at the floor on absence of evidence only.

outcome_analysis: Skysheet was a stealth web spreadsheet in the W09 batch that Spring 2009 Demo Day coverage said had not officially launched. It faced Google and Zoho. No launch, shutdown reason or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public; the factors listed are inferences from the dominant incumbents.
notes: skysheet.com did not resolve in this session. CB Insights (single database, seen in search summary) reports about $20K over two rounds with a Seed II dated 2009-01-28 naming ACE & Company; the amount of that round is not given.
